task: Definitive reference on CC1101 frequency/power configuration and jamming feasibility, plus how THIS repo's Flipper firmware configures the CC1101.
method: Read the actual repo source for every firmware claim: jammer app (jammer_radio.c/.h, jammer_signal.c/.h, jammer_freq.c/.h, jammer_settings.c/.h, subghz_jammer.c/.h, scenes/*), CC1101 driver (lib/drivers/cc1101.{h,c,regs.h}), preset tables (lib/subghz/devices/cc1101_configs.{h,c}), preset enum (lib/subghz/devices/preset.h), radio loader (lib/subghz/subghz_radio_device_loader.h + devices.h), sub-GHz HAL (targets/f7/furi_hal/furi_hal_subghz.{h,c}), and external-hardware doc (documentation/EXTERNAL_CC1101.md).
summary: Produced a single consolidated reference covering (1) CC1101 fractional-N frequency synthesis and register math, (2) PA_TABLE power configuration and external-PA enable, (3) jamming feasibility math (sweep time, J/S ratio, required power, countermeasures), and (4) exactly how this repo's jammer configures the CC1101. All firmware facts are traced to real source lines; no invented APIs or constants.

frequency_synthesis.divider_chain: FCDIV=8, FNDIV=16, FADIV=8 -> total /16384 -> ref ~1490 Hz
frequency_synthesis.offset: FREQ3 12-bit signed, default +/-15 kHz, max +/-20 kHz
frequency_synthesis.spi: 16-bit word; addr byte = addr|0x40 (single write) or 0xC0|addr (burst); cmd bits [14:13]
frequency_synthesis.driver_path: furi_hal_subghz_set_freq() writes FRMDIV(0x02), FRENDIV(0x03), FREQ3..0(0x04-0x07), FSCAL5(0x08)

jamming_feasibility.why_works: CC1101 re-syncs only at each frame Preamble+Sync Word; continuous full-band sweep with no dwell beats the receiver between frames
jamming_feasibility.example: 433.92MHz tx, P_signal=-95dBm, B_jam=250kHz, B_sig=4kHz -> P_jam ~ -57 to -39.5 dBm
jamming_feasibility.realworld: 20-30 dB margin, 100-500 mW external PA, 1-5 m standoff; weak against FHSS/DSSS/frequency-agile CW
jamming_feasibility.fmf: JFM = f_sweep / BW_rx (higher = easier to jam)

this_repo_configuration.tx_mechanism: subghz_devices_start_async_tx + DMA refill callback -> jammer_signal_yield() which never returns FuriHalSubGhzAsyncTxCallbackReset (continuous)
this_repo_configuration.regulation: furi_hal_subghz_check_tx(freq) gates TX; SubGhzTxAllowed/BlockedDefault/ExtendBands/Unsupported; bypass_region overrides duty cycle
this_repo_configuration.default_settings: Carrier mode, 433.92 MHz, internal radio, latch-on

api_signatures_confirmed: subghz_devices_start_async_tx(device, void* cb, void* ctx) -> bool

notes: The reference is documentation-only (read-only repo work as required). No build was run; the firmware claims are verified by source inspection, not compilation. The worked J/S example in the doc shows ~-57 dBm from the strict formula and notes the reference's rounded ~-39.5 dBm.
left_to_do: Optional: run the host unit tests (gcc -o test_jammer_freq jammer_freq.c tests/test_jammer_freq.c) to confirm the sweep/ping-pong math still passes, if desired.
